no_go_conditions: Available disk is below 10 GiB before installing tools or writing predictor sidecars.
Pocket predictor is not pinned and reproducible, or predictor outputs are not retained with version/provenance.
The evaluation uses M-CSA catalytic coordinates as predictor inputs instead of gold labels only.
More than 5 percent of sampled local structures fail parsing under the chosen predictor.
Top-3 any-catalytic-residue recall is below 0.80 on the current702 smoke/validation subset.
Required cofactor capture is below 0.70 for holo rows with local cofactor evidence.
False positive pocket neighborhoods inflate active-site encoder feature coverage without improving heldout diagnostics.
Chain/entity mismatches exceed 2 percent or cannot be automatically diagnosed.
Apo selected structures dominate failures and no holo structure-selection policy is approved.
Any proposed pocket-derived feature would require label, ontology, threshold, import, production scoring, or model-output edits before review.
